$comment: TEST-ONLY Ed25519 key material. The private key is published here DELIBERATELY: these vectors are worthless without it, and a key whose private half is in a public repository can never be mistaken for a production signer. Production trust configuration must never contain these, and there is no default trust root that would admit them - an absent trust root fails execution authorization closed rather than falling back to anything.
$format: PKCS#8 (private) and X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (public), standard Base64 with padding.
